mapper.insert: INSERT INTO child ( name, birth_status, expected_birth_date, birth_date, gender, profile_image_url, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{birthStatus}, #{expectedBirthDate}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{profileImageUrl}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO child_parent ( child_id, member_id, relation_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{memberId}, #{relationType}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT IGNORE INTO child_parent ( child_id, member_id, relation_type, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT DISTINCT #{childId}, guardian.member_id, guardian.relation_type, NOW(), NOW() FROM child_parent requester_child INNER JOIN child managed_child ON managed_child.child_id = requester_child.child_id INNER JOIN child_parent guardian ON guardian.child_id = requester_child.child_id INNER JOIN member guardian_member ON guardian_member.member_id = guardian.member_id WHERE requester_child.member_id = #{memberId} AND guardian.member_id != #{memberId} AND managed_child.status = 'ACTIVE' AND guardian_member.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.name AS name, c.birth_status AS birthStatus, c.birth_date AS birthDate, c.expected_birth_date AS expectedBirthDate, CASE WHEN c.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, CURDATE()) END AS age, c.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, cp.relation_type AS relationType FROM child c INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON c.child_id = cp.child_id WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.name AS name, c.birth_status AS birthStatus, c.expected_birth_date AS expectedBirthDate, c.birth_date AS birthDate, c.gender AS gender, c.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, CASE WHEN c.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, CURDATE()) END AS age, cp.relation_type AS relationType, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM child c INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON c.child_id = cp.child_id WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT child_id AS childId, allowance_request_enabled AS allowanceRequestEnabled, usage_limit_view_enabled AS usageLimitViewEnabled FROM child WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE child SET allowance_request_enabled = #{allowanceRequestEnabled}, usage_limit_view_enabled = #{usageLimitViewEnabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE child
name = #{name}, birth_status = #{birthStatus}, expected_birth_date = #{expectedBirthDate}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE child SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.name AS childName, c.birth_status AS birthStatus, c.expected_birth_date AS expectedBirthDate FROM child c INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = c.child_id WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
